definitions.explanation: A person or thing being considered for selection.

examples.japanese: {候補|こうほ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挙|あ}がる→挙がる：30433_agaru⟧。
examples.english: To be nominated as a candidate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次期|じき}→次期：19838_jiki⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候補|こうほ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、3⟦{名|めい}→〜名：04015_mei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挙|あ}がって→挙がる：30433_agaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Three names have been put forward as candidates for the next company president.

notes:
{候補|こうほ} refers to a candidate, nominee, or potential option under consideration.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {候補|こうほ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挙|あ}がる→挙がる：30433_agaru⟧: to be nominated, to come up as a candidate
- {候補|こうほ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧: to narrow down the candidates
- {候補|こうほ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to run as a candidate
- {候補|こうほ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: to drop out of the running

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧: candidate (person)
- {候補|こうほ}⟦{地|ち}→〜地：09852_chi⟧: candidate location/site
- {候補|こうほ}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: nominated work

USAGE:
Used in both political contexts (election candidates) and everyday contexts (choosing from options like restaurants or travel destinations).
